newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Bergen County, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY OF NOTICE OF SALE
The BOROUGH OF FAIR LAWN, in the
County of Bergen, New Jersey
NOTICE OF $15,948,000 BOND SALE
(Book Entry Only) (Non-Callable)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Borough Council
of the Borough of Fair Lawn, in the County of Bergen, New
Jersey, at the Municipal Building, 8-01 Fair Lawn Avenue,
Fair Lawn, New Jersey, on
until 11:00 o'clock A.M. at which time they will be publicly
opened and announced, for the purchase of the following
issue or issues of Bonds of said Borough due (without option
of prior redemption) on August 1 as follows:
$2,648,000 Water Bonds of 1997, maturing in the
principal amount of $110,000 in each of the years
1998 to 2002, both inclusive, $215,000 in each of
the years 2003 to 2009, both inclusive, $200,000
in each of the years 2010 to 2011, and $193,000 in
$13,300,000 General Bonds of 1997, maturing in the
principal amount of $625,000 in each of the years
1998 to 2000, both inclusive, $700,000 in the year
the years 2003 to 2010, both inclusive.
The Bonds will be dated August 1, 1997, and will bear
interest, payable on the first days of February and August
in each year until maturity, at the rate per annum
specified, in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%, by the
successful bidder therefor in accordance with the full
Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form
only with one certificate for the aggregate principal amount
of the Bonds maturing in each year.
Copies of the full Notice of Sale, the Proposal for Bonds,
the Preliminary Official Statement and the form of legal
opinion of Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, bond counsel to the
Borough, may be obtained from Joanne M. Kwasniewski, Borough
Clerk, Municipal Building, 8-01 Fair Lawn Avenue, Fair Lawn,
New Jersey, 07410 (Telephone: 201-796-1700).
JOANNE M. KWASNIEWSKI
Borough Clerk
Dated: July 14, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
